title: Authorization, Origin admission and deliverability are separate
method: capsuleForConsumer judges Consumer Authorization (lineage), then Origin Execution Admission (SELECTED, BOUND_VERIFIED, ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT), then Capsule Deliverability (byte budget), each with its own typed refusal
observed: AMBIGUOUS/REQUESTED_NOT_QUALIFIED origin => ORIGIN_NOT_SELECTED; unavailable source => ORIGIN_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; invalid/failed page => ORIGIN_PAGE_REFUSED; no qualified association => NO_QUALIFIED_ORIGIN; over budget => CAPSULE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. A successful Capsule satisfies the full §8.4 conjunction
expectedInvariant: a lawful consumer lineage does not automatically imply a qualified historical Execution Capsule
remainingUncertainty: an Ephemeral origin is refused only where durability is REQUIRED by the caller; the Capsule records durability rather than refusing it outright
